description: Export a curated GitHub source tree. Keep current core regression tests and exclude historical release-only tests, duplicate fixtures and maintenance-only tools. Local authoring tests are not deleted. Release notes and bilingual commit summaries belong beside ZIP/MSI, never in source exports.

important_coverage: installer launch, upgrade, folder picker and completion rendering
v1.1.0 scoped UI state, selected profile snapshots, solid menus and close progress
test_policy.review_rule: Add new tests only for active important behavior; remove superseded fixtures together with their runner scripts after dependency and regression verification.

release_changes.commit_title: Refine profile workflows, menu styling, responsive close progress and desktop shortcut publication
release_changes.commit_title_zh: 优化配置流程、菜单外观、关闭进度与桌面快捷方式创建

changes.change: Update the product identity to v1.1.0.
changes.change_zh: 将程序版本标识更新为 v1.1.0。

changes.change: Export a clean source tree and write the bilingual top-level commit summary beside ZIP/MSI, outside source.
changes.change_zh: 导出干净源码，并将中英双语的顶层修改说明保存到 ZIP/MSI 同级，不放进源码。

changes.change: Exclude release documents and obsolete tests, retain essential regression coverage and bilingual release summaries.
changes.change_zh: 排除发布文档与老旧测试，保留重要回归测试及双语发布说明。

changes.change: Move release notes outside authoring and exported source; keep them beside distributable packages.
changes.change_zh: 更新日志移出正式源码与导出源码，仅与发布包同级存放。

changes.change: Generate this summary in the release directory rather than the source directory.
changes.change_zh: 此修改说明改在发布目录生成，不再放入源码目录。

changes.change: Simplify profile saving, refresh selection counts, improve theme/focus/localization behavior and close progress; keep closed selectors adaptive and expanded lists opaque; isolate tray-menu colors.
changes.change_zh: 简化配置保存、修复选择统计，优化主题、焦点、多语言与关闭进度；闭合下拉框保持自适应，展开列表使用纯色，并隔离托盘菜单配色。

changes.change: Keep v1.1.0 upgrade compatibility and publish desktop shortcuts at the saved or tail location before Explorer redraw, rather than move them on Finish. Decouple shortcut creation from Explorer placement; retain saved links when view access, redraw or positioning fails, and report real save errors.
changes.change_zh: 保留 v1.1.0 覆盖安装兼容性，在 Explorer 重绘前将桌面快捷方式放到原位置或末尾，不再点击完成后移动。 快捷方式创建不再依赖桌面定位；桌面视图、重绘或定位失败也保留有效图标，并明确报告实际保存失败。

changes.change: Cover profile/selection workflows, multilingual layout, solid popup versus adaptive closed selectors, desktop publication order, cleanup failure recovery and clean source exports. Verify actual shortcut targets, working directories and icons under unavailable-view and failed-placement scenarios.
changes.change_zh: 覆盖配置与选择流程、多语言布局、展开纯色与闭合自适应、桌面创建时序、失败清理和干净源码导出。 新增真实快捷方式文件回归，验证桌面视图不可用、定位失败时的目标路径、工作目录和图标。
